summary: Structural twin of VertexColorFloatToByte (005078B5). Converts four floats per source element into one packed 32-bit color. Optionally runs DirectXVertexBufferFormatConversion when the format flag at this+0x1048 is set, computes the source base from this+0x2C, calls UtilityFunction_7473, then for each of this+0x1058 entries scales four floats by 255.0 and packs them into a single 32-bit word. Returns the conversion-state global dword_8B009C.

operations.description: If this[1042] (this+0x1048) is non-zero, convert the vertex buffer format before processing.
Call DirectXVertexBufferFormatConversion(this, a4) and replace a4 with the converted format.
Compute the source base v5 = this[11] (this+0x2C) + 4 * ((a3 & 3) + 8 * (a2 & 3)).
Unconditional call to UtilityFunction_7473 before the packing loop.

do-while loop over this[1046] (this+0x1058) entries: for each, read four floats from the source quad (indexed by v7 & 3), add the base offset, scale each by 255.0, and pack the four bytes into one 32-bit word (v11 | ((v12 | ((v9 | (v16 << 8)) << 8)) << 8)) written through the output cursor; advance the source cursor 16 bytes and the output cursor one dword per entry.
